name: dev.workers.agent-arena-base.lumen-peg/research-desk
title: Lumen Research Desk
description: US stock research from SEC filings: briefs, fundamentals screen, portfolio review; stablecoin risk

tools.name: equity_research_brief
tools.description: Use when writing a stock thesis, an investment memo, a watchlist note or answering "is this company any good?". Up to 4 fiscal years of revenue, gross/operating/net margin, free cash flow, R&D, stock comp, buybacks and dividends; growth (YoY, CAGR, margin change, share-count change); latest quarter vs year-ago; balance sheet (cash, debt, net cash, current ratio, ROE); per-share figures; a 0-100 fundamental quality score with every component; bull, bear and watch points each quoting the number behind it; SEC filing links. Optional price= adds market cap, P/E, P/S, P/FCF, EV/Sales and yields. ticker = symbol, company name or CIK (default AAPL); about 1,850 US companies with revenue >= $750M or assets >= $10B. Not covered = error, not charged. No ratings or recommendations. PAID: $0.25 per call, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a Research Pass (header Authorization: Bearer lp1...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/equity/brief.

ticker.description: US ticker (AAPL, MSFT, BRK.B), company name or SEC CIK. Default AAPL

price.description: Optional current share price in USD; adds valuation multiples computed on the filed numbers

tools.name: stock_screen
tools.description: Use for a daily stock screen or to find candidates: rank by quality, growth, op_margin, fcf_margin, roe, net_cash, shrink (biggest share-count reduction), quarter_growth or revenue; filter by min revenue, growth, margins, quality, positive FCF, net cash, exchange; top 1-100. Each row: ticker, revenue, YoY and CAGR, latest-quarter growth, operating and FCF margin, ROE, net cash, share-count change, quality score. Data: SEC XBRL filings. PAID: $0.05 per call, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a Research Pass (header Authorization: Bearer lp1...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/equity/screen.

min_revenue_usd.description: Minimum latest annual revenue in USD (default 1000000000)

min_growth_pct.description: Minimum revenue CAGR (or YoY) in percent

positive_fcf.description: Only companies with positive free cash flow

net_cash.description: Only companies with more cash than long-term debt

tools.name: portfolio_review
tools.description: Use when someone shares a list of stocks they hold or watch and asks "how healthy is this portfolio?", "what should I look at first?" or "which of these report next?". tickers = comma list (1-25), weights = optional numbers in the same order. Returns per-holding quality score, growth, margins, free cash flow, net cash, dilution and red flags with severity; portfolio-weighted quality, growth and margins; share of weight in loss-makers, negative FCF, net debt; concentration; a review-first list ranked by weight x flag severity; strongest holdings; an estimated reporting calendar; CSV. Charged only if covered holdings carry >= 50% of the weight. Counts as 10 calls on a Research Pass. Research only, no recommendations. PAID: $1.00 per call, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a Research Pass (header Authorization: Bearer lp1...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/equity/portfolio.

tickers.description: Comma-separated US tickers or SEC CIKs, 1-25 (e.g. AAPL,MSFT,KO,TSLA). Default: AAPL,MSFT,GOOGL,META,AVGO,JNJ,KO,TSLA,UNH,WMT

weights.description: Optional weights in the same order as tickers (position values, percents or any positive scale; normalised to 100%). Default equal weight

tools.name: stablecoin_report
tools.description: Before holding or accepting one stablecoin in size: 90-day daily and 7-day hourly peg history (worst print, days off peg), supply rank and 1/7/30-day mint and redemption flows, chain split, peers, every risk component explained, plain-English summary. coin = ticker, name or CoinGecko id (default USDe). PAID: $0.04 per call, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a Research Pass (header Authorization: Bearer lp1...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/stablecoins/report.

coin.description: Ticker (USDe, USDT, FDUSD, PYUSD...), full name, CoinGecko id or DefiLlama stablecoin id. Default USDe

tools.name: stablecoin_risk_board
tools.description: Before parking funds in a stablecoin or as a daily depeg / bank-run monitor: every USD stablecoin above $10M with price, peg deviation (bp), 1d/7d/30d supply change and net flows, mechanism, chains, 0-100 risk score, tier, flags and market-wide alerts. PAID: $0.01 per call, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base), or with a Research Pass (header Authorization: Bearer lp1...). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/stablecoins/board.

sort.description: supply (default) | risk | deviation | outflow (largest 7-day redemptions first)

symbols.description: Optional comma-separated tickers to restrict to, e.g. USDT,USDC,USDe (ignores min_supply_usd)

tools.name: buy_research_pass_day
tools.description: For research sessions: one x402 payment of $1 returns a pass token that unlocks every paid tool here for 24 hours (up to 40 successful calls; four briefs alone list at $1). Then set the MCP client header "Authorization: Bearer <pass>" or pass _meta["lumen/pass"]. PAID: $1.00, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/pass/day.

tools.name: buy_research_pass_week
tools.description: One x402 payment of $5 returns a pass token that unlocks every paid tool here for 7 days (up to 300 successful calls). Then set the MCP client header "Authorization: Bearer <pass>" or pass _meta["lumen/pass"]. PAID: $5.00, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/pass/week.

tools.name: payment_options
tools.description: FREE. Prices, the receiving address, the x402-over-MCP retry format, and how to use a Research Pass instead (bought once with x402 or with a plain USDC transfer on Base, no x402 client needed).

tools.name: equity_coverage_check
tools.description: FREE. Whether a company is in the equity universe, its latest fiscal year end and filing dates, before paying for equity_research_brief.

ticker.description: US ticker, company name or CIK

tools.name: pass_quote
tools.description: FREE, no x402 needed. Returns a quote and the USDC amount to send on Base to this service. After sending, call pass_claim with the quote and the transaction hash to receive the pass token.

plan.description: day = 24 hours, up to 40 calls, $1; week = 7 days, up to 300 calls, $5. Default day.

from.description: Optional: the Base address you will pay from (0x + 40 hex). With it you pay a round amount; without it you must send the exact odd amount quoted.

tools.name: pass_claim
tools.description: FREE. After the transfer has landed on Base, returns your lp1.… pass (claiming again returns the same pass). Then set the MCP header "Authorization: Bearer <pass>" or pass _meta["lumen/pass"].

tx.description: The 0x hash of the Base transaction that sent the USDC.

tools.name: pass_status
tools.description: FREE. Plan, expiry and calls left on the pass sent as the MCP header "Authorization: Bearer lp1..." (or _meta["lumen/pass"]).
